title: Pair With Target Sum
statement: A sorted list of item prices is given. Decide whether two different items together cost exactly the target amount.
input_format: The first line contains n and target. The second line contains n integers in non-decreasing order.
output_format: Print YES if two different positions add up to target, otherwise NO.
constraints: 2 ≤ n ≤ 100000; values and target are between -1000000000 and 1000000000.
hints: Because the list is sorted, moving left makes sums smaller and moving right makes them larger.
Start one pointer at each end and compare their sum with the target.
Move the left pointer when the sum is too small and the right pointer when it is too large.
